svg.text: T1 HOUSEHOLD UNIT — 5,000 L FERROCEMENT TANK
Plan, section and reinforcement detail. Scale 1:50 unless noted.
Hoop stress at base of full tank 0.69 MPa | allowable 3.0 MPa | factor of safety 4.3
Armature is the structure. Mortar is only the matrix — do not reduce the wire layers to save cost.
25 mm haunch: no sharp internal corner
Ø8 rod continues into base and turns 90°
base slab 100 mm, 1:2:4, weld mesh both ways
Curing: keep damp for 7 days. A tank cured dry cracks, and a cracked tank leaks.
1. All dimensions in millimetres unless shown in metres.
2. Ferrocement to be built on a level, firm base; never on
3. Cover cast separately, cured, then sealed with 1:2 mortar
4. Tank must be sited ≥ 900 mm from the house wall.
5. Anchor the cover to the wall with 4 no. M8 stainless
bolts — this is a cyclone-country requirement.
6. Test: fill, hold 24 h, top up, hold 24 h. Loss must be
< 1% of capacity or the shell is re-rendered.
7. Do not site under a tree: leaf load blocks the gutter and
8. Ground must be firm and level: bearing capacity ≥ 50 kN/m².
Never build on filled, organic or seasonally flooded ground.
